description: Expected first-line error messages per device/permission state (F-1202 ceremony device diagnosis). Used by the ceremony harness to validate plain-English error rendering.

states.label: No video input device found
states.expectedFirstLine: I can't find a camera on this machine — is one plugged in? When it is, tap Retry.

states.label: No audio input device found
states.expectedFirstLine: I can't find a microphone on this machine — is one plugged in? When it is, tap Retry.

states.label: Browser blocked camera/mic access
states.expectedFirstLine: Your browser is blocking the camera. Tap Allow when it asks — or use the lock icon in the address bar.

states.label: Camera held by another application
states.expectedFirstLine: Another app is using your camera. Close it, then tap Retry.

states.label: Wrong audio route (Continuity/display/BT mic — silent track)
states.expectedFirstLine: Very low input. Your browser may be using a different microphone than the one you're speaking into
